title: Getting started
text: Before your first week is complete, acknowledge the employee handbook and review your onboarding checklist. Your assigned manager approves workspace access. People Ops coordinates any blocked tasks.

title: Workspace access
text: Workspace access requires approval from the employee’s assigned manager. AI assistants may explain policy and request People Ops review, but cannot approve access. If provisioning fails, People Ops retries the retained task after reviewing the failure.

title: Remote equipment
text: New hires may request a standard laptop and headset through People Ops. The manager confirms the role requirements before an equipment order is placed. This demo does not define a reimbursement amount or shipping commitment.

title: Getting help
text: When a task is blocked or a policy does not cover your situation, request People Ops review. Include the task and the information you need. Escalation creates a review item; it does not bypass an approval or change an employee’s access.
